title: CRServo: Continuous Rotation Servo

hints.title: CRServo vs regular Servo
hints.content: A regular `Servo` uses `setPosition(0.0 to 1.0)` for angular position. A `CRServo` uses `setPower(-1.0 to 1.0)` for continuous spinning — there's no position to set.

hints.title: The trigger subtraction pattern
hints.content: `intake.setPower(gamepad1.right_trigger - gamepad1.left_trigger)` is clean and idiomatic. Triggers range 0.0 to 1.0. If only right is pressed: power = positive (intake). If only left is pressed: power = negative (eject). Both released: power = 0.
